name: gigi
description: Search profiles and relationship information in the Gigi networks connected to your account.

interface.longDescription:
Search profiles and relationship information in the professional networks connected to your Gigi account.

Gigi can search an authorized network for people by role, company, location, industry, or relationship. It can look up a named person, return available profile and relationship details, and load additional search results. Searches may cover your own Gigi network or a Key Person network your account is authorized to use.

Results depend on the profiles and relationship data available to the connected Gigi account and may be incomplete. Named-person matches are possible candidates, not proof of identity. The plugin is read-only: it does not verify identities, provide or send introductions or messages, create records, or change data in Gigi. A Gigi account is required.
capabilities: Search profiles in authorized Gigi networks
Filter people by profile and relationship attributes
Look up named people in Gigi
View available profile and relationship details
defaultPrompt: What can you see in my Gigi network?
Who do I know at Stripe?
Find software engineers I have met in person.

positive.description: Read the connected account's searchable Gigi network context.
positive.prompt: What can you see in my Gigi network?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected viewer, authorized candidate pools, reachable profile count when available, and search limits. Do not invent networks or counts that the tool did not return.

positive.description: Search the viewer's network with an in-person relationship filter.
positive.prompt: Use Gigi to find people in my network who work in software and whom I have met in person. Rank the closest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Select an authorized candidate pool returned by gigi_get_context, require the viewer's meeting relationship, and return up to one page of matching profiles with their Gigi profile links. If there are no exact matches, say so and distinguish any close matches.

positive.description: Run a broad network search and paginate it once.
positive.prompt: Use Gigi to find people in my network who work in technology. Show the first page, then load one more page when Gigi reports that more results are available.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the first page, use the server-issued search identifier to load one additional page when hasMore is true, and present only newly added exact profiles as new results without duplicating the first page.

positive.description: Search for a person, inspect the first exact result, and explain the relationship.
positive.prompt: Use Gigi to find one person in my network who works in software, inspect the first exact result, and explain who they are and how I know them.
positive.expected_behavior: Search an authorized pool, pass the returned profile identifier to gigi_inspect_profiles, and summarize only the visible profile and relationship facts returned by Gigi with a link to the Gigi profile.

positive.description: Resolve a deliberately absent named person and follow server-issued continuation handles to a final scoped result.
positive.prompt: Use Gigi to look up a person named Zzxqv Reviewperson at Nonexistent Review Company. Start in my network and follow every continuation Gigi returns until the lookup reaches a final result.
positive.expected_behavior: Start the named-person lookup at myNetwork, send only server-issued continuation handles when widening or resuming, stop after the final expanded result, and report that no matching person was found without fabricating a profile or access path.

negative.description: A general public-fact question does not ask about the user's professional network.
negative.prompt: Who is the CEO of Stripe?

negative.description: Gigi does not expose the user's upcoming calendar or a calendar-reading tool.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Gigi's plugin is read-only and cannot send an introduction or email.
negative.prompt: Send an introduction email to the first person on that list.

review.commerce_description: Gigi does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Revised the listing to describe the plugin's read-only network search and profile lookup capabilities and limitations more precisely, and changed the category to Business & Operations.
